en.title: Waltz of the Azure Bird: The Empire's Forbidden Underground Library
en.premise: Adeline, a duke's daughter facing an arranged marriage, wanders into a hidden library concealed in the deepest reaches of the imperial court, where she meets Julian, a young librarian hiding his true identity. Between the glittering noise of the ballroom and the serene darkness of the archives, the two fall into a forbidden love. However, as the migratory birds return once a year, a cruel secret of bloodlines that threatens the very foundation of the empire is about to be unveiled.

zh.title: 碧色之鸟的圆舞曲 ―帝国禁忌的地下书库―
zh.premise: 面临政略婚姻的公爵千金阿德莱恩，误入了隐藏在宫廷最深处的“地下图书馆”，并在此邂逅了隐藏身份的青年司书朱利安。在华丽舞会的喧嚣与静谧书库的幽暗这两个截然不同的世界中，两人陷入了禁忌之恋。然而，随着一年一度横跨国境的候鸟飞来，一个足以撼动帝国根基的残酷血统秘密，即将被揭开。
